shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "cat AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next.config.ts ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- app files ---\\n' && for f in app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/preview/page.tsx app/news/page.tsx; do echo \"--- "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -c "git diff -- package.json && printf '\\n--- tracked files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' | sort | head -250 && printf '\\n--- next docs ---\\n' && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg -i 'cache|route|use-cache' | head -100"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md && printf '\\n--- cacheComponents config ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md && printf '\\n--- cacheLife ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- use-cache ---' && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md && printf '\\n--- cookies ---\\n' && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | rg '/cookies\\.md"'$'"' | xargs -r sed -n '1,240p' && printf '\\n--- package scripts & TS config ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- nested instructions ---\\n' && find app -name AGENTS.md -print"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n \"revalidate|dynamic|Suspense|cookies\\(\\)|instant = false|route segment configs\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md | head -90 && printf '\\n--- relevant migration excerpt ---\\n' && sed -n '90,255p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n -C 3 \"Suspense|cookies\\(\\)|request time|request-specific|Dynamic APIs\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/functions/cookies.md | head -120 && printf '\\n--- cacheLife profile details ---\\n' && rg -n -C 2 \"'hours'|hours|revalidate\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md | head -100"

/bin/bash -c "rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg '/cookies\\.md"'$|/cacheLife'"\\.md"'$'"' | head -20 && sed -n '285,345p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md && sed -n '1,115p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cookies.md 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/bash -c 'git diff -- package.json && git status --short --branch && git diff --stat'

/bin/bash -c "git status --short && printf '\\n--- tracked diff ---\\n' && git diff -- next.config.ts app/news/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- route opt-outs/configs ---\\n' && rg -n \"instant\\s*=\\s*false|dynamic\\s*=|revalidate\\s*=|fetchCache\\s*=\" app next.config.ts || true && git diff --check"

/bin/bash -c "git status --short --branch && git diff --check && printf '\\n--- route settings ---\\n' && rg -n \"instant\\s*=\\s*false|dynamic\\s*=|revalidate\\s*=|fetchCache\\s*=\" app next.config.ts || true && printf '\\n--- numbered changes ---\\n' && nl -ba next.config.ts && nl -ba app/news/page.tsx && nl -ba app/preview/page.tsx"
